text: Entry Requirements Age 22 years old or younger. For Science and engineering programs, the scores of mathematics,physics and chemistry subject should be C at the minimum or 65% at the minimum. For economics and management programs, the scores of mathematics should be C at the minimum or 65% at the minimum. For medicine programs, the scores of mathematics,physics, chemistry and biology subjects should be C at the minimum or 65% at the minimum. English teachiing courses should provide TOEFL scord of 60 at the minimum, IELTS scores of 5.0 at the minimum, or proof English as learning or working language.
